reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getExpectedScheduleAmount helper that every ranged-amount path (template, forecast, posting, action sync, preview, getScheduledAmount for the UI) already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the single definition is rewritten.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines expected schedule amounts.

scope.why: Focused, apart from an unrelated import reordering in server/schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: The rounding parameter is now dead (renamed _rounding) but kept in the signature, and schedule-template still computes and passes 'template', leaving a misleading vestigial option instead of removing it.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; one function body changed.

one_place.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app (two sites), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and getScheduledAmount.
